  decision = {A \texttt{replay} service behind a Compose profile, in a monitoring image that CD pushes with each release, is started by hand, locally or on the VM over SSH.
It sends control listings of \texttt{train} outside the drift reference, then the \texttt{ES} holdout, and posts each observed price to \texttt{/\allowbreak{}v1/\allowbreak{}feedback}.
It shifts \texttt{registration\_\allowbreak{}date} by the whole months since 2025-11-08.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item A \texttt{deploy.\allowbreak{}sh replay} subcommand started from a workflow: no VPN needed, but it widens EDN-94's sudo rule for the runner.
\item A seller-grouped held-out set as control: EDN-14 measured that such a control gets flagged.
\item The replay inside the API image: NFR-04 keeps that image the serving runtime.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} There are no real users (EDN-13), so the replay is the traffic.
Only a control i.i.d. with the reference lets NFR-11's control clause pass; its error and coverage are in-sample, so \#229 compares them with \texttt{metrics.\allowbreak{}json}.
Without the shift, a 2025 listing sent in November 2026 is a year older than in training, which flags \texttt{age\_\allowbreak{}years} in every control window.},

  assessment = {AI proposed the design and built it.

A local run logged 600 of 600 listings with their prices.},
